transcript.customer: What is your cancellation policy?
transcript.agent:
According to our **Cancellation and Late Arrival Policy**:

* **Cancelling more than 24 hours ahead:** You can cancel any booking free of charge up to 24 hours before its start time (Cancelling more than 24 hours ahead).
* **Cancelling within 24 hours:** If you cancel less than 24 hours before the start time, a late cancellation fee of 50% of the session price applies. This fee is added to your account and paid at your next visit (Cancelling within 24 hours).
* **Illness and emergencies:** If you cancel within 24 hours because of illness or an emergency, let the front desk know; we waive the fee once every six months (Illness and emergencies).
* **When we cancel:** If the studio has to cancel or move your booking, there is never a charge, and we will offer you the nearest free alternatives (When we cancel).
